name: tiger-skills
description: Harness engineering (outer loop) + code quality (inner loop): a lean, linear single-feature pipeline. grill writes one compact markdown feature.md (merged spec/ADR/business) + a broad Robot e2e suite and cuts feature/<id> from dev; the lead — the merged architect + e2e gate — then owns the whole build in one context: it plans where the code goes and keeps tiger/CODEBASE_MAP.md, SPAWNS tiger-code-generator subagents itself (parallel git worktrees, strict TDD, a simplify pass, NO comments in generated code), then authors + runs the Robot suite for real (Playwright for UI) as the single quality gate — triaging by priority and re-planning the delta in-context on HIGH/MEDIUM — and on a clean pass hands off to update-docs to refresh the markdown docs and fast-forward merge to dev (main stays protected; dev→main is manual). tiger-security / tiger-reviewer are standalone on-demand gates. 3 agents, 15 skills, a deterministic git-committed Workflow. Based on the walkinglabs learn-tiger-grill course.
